logline: Following their illicit passion in the abandoned manor wing, Catherine negotiates Father Thomas's corrupt silence with territorial control—unaware that Agnes has walked in and witnessed their scandalous intimacy.

moments.description: Catherine flirts with Father Thomas about his stamina, to which he dryly reminds her that a man of the cloth shouldn't be in her bed at all.
moments.key_dialogue: A man in my collar isn't supposed to be in this bed at all.

moments.description: Catherine asks Father Thomas to name his price for his silence, and he demands full territorial control of tax collection routed through his office.
moments.key_dialogue: The west territory. Tax collection, all of it. Routed through my office.

moments.description: Catherine balks at the steep price of his discretion, but Father Thomas coldly states that absolution is free while discretion is not.
moments.key_dialogue: Absolution is free. Discretion has a price.

moments.description: Catherine pulls Father Thomas closer into a fierce and suffocating embrace, surrendering completely to their forbidden passion.
moments.key_dialogue: Or perhaps discretion isn't the only thing you've developed a taste for.

moments.description: Agnes walks down the corridor with a lantern, peers through an open door, and discovers Catherine locked in a passionate embrace with the shirtless priest.
